user_question: Find 5 Indian B2B SaaS startups in HR tech and summarize their positioning
short_answer: Five prominent Indian B2B SaaS startups in the HR tech space are Darwinbox, Keka, greytHR, inFeedo (Amber), and Leena AI. Their market positioning spans full-lifecycle enterprise Human Capital Management (Darwinbox), user-centric mid-market payroll & automation (Keka, greytHR), and AI-driven conversational employee engagement and helpdesk automation (inFeedo, Leena AI).

key_findings.statement: Darwinbox positions itself as a mobile-first, enterprise-grade HCM platform for large enterprises across Asia, competing directly with SAP SuccessFactors and Workday with comprehensive hire-to-retire modules.
Keka focuses on mid-sized enterprises, positioning around high-usability employee experience, automated payroll processing, and attendance tracking with minimal implementation friction.
greytHR caters primarily to Indian SMBs with a focus on compliant statutory payroll calculations (PF, ESI, TDS) and cloud-based core HR administration.

inFeedo positions its flagship AI bot 'Amber' as a predictive employee retention and sentiment analytics platform that proactively identifies attrition risks through continuous conversational check-ins.
Leena AI positions itself as an autonomous employee experience platform integrating generative AI and automated service desk resolution across HR, IT, and workplace workflows.

assumptions: Selected companies with verified Indian headquarters or founding origins catering to B2B SaaS workflows.
Evaluated companies with established market presence and verifiable positioning copy.
limitations: Pricing tiers and exact employee headcount minimums were not consistently documented across public marketing copy.
next_steps: Filter candidates by current company size to determine whether enterprise solutions (Darwinbox) or mid-market solutions (Keka) best fit deployment scope.
Request vendor demos focusing on integration with existing ERP and identity providers.
